V0614_01_00_00_0.text: Blue Maiden taught Miyu to be brave, so I can be brave too!

V0614_01_00_01_0.text:
This Duel will be fierce.
I'm sorry I dragged you into this.

V0614_01_00_01_1.text:
Don't be.
This was never just your fight!
It's mine as well!

V0614_01_00_03_0.text: This'll be nothing compared to what Miyu had to endure!

V0614_01_00_04_0.text:
I'm upgrading my game!
Say hello to Blue Maiden!

V0614_01_00_05_0.text:
Ai, you and Playmaker are a tough team.
But we're stronger.

V0614_01_00_06_0.text: Flame, I'd love to see how you and Soulburner get along.

V0614_01_00_07_0.text: This is me at my best, Ghost Gal!

V0614_01_00_08_0.text:
Akira!
I'm getting stronger day by day, Duel by Duel!

V0614_01_00_09_0.text: I cannot allow you to control the future!

V0614_03_00_00_0.text:
Be careful.
They may still have one last move they can make.

V0614_03_00_00_1.text:

It's my turn!

V0614_03_00_01_0.text: This is your chance, Blue Maiden!

V0614_03_00_01_1.text:
Time to go all out!
My turn!

V0614_03_00_03_0.text:
Let's take it slow.
We don't know what they're planning.

V0614_03_00_04_0.text:
Just believe in our Deck!
And in yourself!

V0614_03_00_04_1.text:
Truer words have never been spoken, Aqua!
It's my turn!

V0614_03_00_05_0.text: This isn't looking good for us...

V0614_03_00_05_1.text: But I know you'll find a way to turn this around!

V0614_05_00_00_0.text:
I'm not giving up!
In fact, I'm only getting started!

V0614_07_09_01_0.text: Now for the card I Set!

V0614_11_10_01_1.text:
I set my monsters in the Link Arrows!
Link the circuit!

V0614_11_10_02_0.text: I'll build the circuit that turns dreams into reality!

V0614_11_10_03_0.text: I'll build the circuit that turns hope into reality!

V0614_15_00_02_0.text: You won't get away from me!

V0614_16_00_01_0.text: This will erase the rest of your LP!

V0614_21_00_00_0.text:
Be careful!
They're not going to back down!

V0614_21_00_00_1.text:
I know!
I end my turn!

V0614_21_00_01_0.text:
That ends my turn!
Nothing stands in our way now!

V0614_21_00_01_1.text:
...You're wrong.
They haven't given up yet!

V0614_21_00_02_1.text: If you keep Dueling this well, you're sure to win!

V0614_21_00_04_0.text: We're entering the most crucial moments of this Duel!

V0614_21_00_04_1.text:
Don't worry. I have a plan!
I end my turn!

V0614_21_00_05_0.text:
Blue Maiden!
We're in tremendous trouble!

V0614_21_00_05_1.text:
That doesn't mean I'm giving up!
I end my turn!

V0614_28_00_00_0.text: Aqua and I built this Marincess Deck together!

V0614_28_00_00_1.text: We're proof that humans and AIs can live together in peace.

V0614_28_00_01_1.text: I'm proud to be partners with someone so courageous.

V0614_28_00_02_0.text: We both have friends and families that we want to protect!

V0614_28_00_02_1.text: That is why we cannot afford to lose.

V0614_28_00_03_0.text: Blue Maiden, how many times have you saved me now?

V0614_28_00_03_1.text:
Who's counting?
We save each other all the time!

V0614_28_00_04_1.text: I should be the one thanking you, Blue Maiden.

V0614_28_00_05_0.text: You've helped me and my brother through thick and thin.

V0614_28_00_06_0.text: I'll become stronger so that I can protect you instead!

V0614_29_00_00_0.text: No one can say we didn't go down without a fight.

V0614_29_00_00_1.text:
You never gave up.
That's why I'm proud to be your partner.

V0614_29_00_02_1.text: They knew exactly how to counter our Deck...

V0614_29_00_03_0.text: All we have to do is just get stronger, right Aqua?

V0614_29_00_03_1.text:
Yes, Blue Maiden.
Let's get stronger together!

V0614_29_00_05_0.text: You're as great at Dueling as you are at hacking, Ghost Gal.

V0614_33_00_02_1.text:

V0614_30_00_00_0.text: There's no better Deck than this!

V0614_30_00_02_0.text: Is that supposed to scare me?

V0614_30_00_03_0.text: You talk like I have no chance to win.

V0614_30_00_04_0.text: This card's effect can get me out of trouble!

V0614_30_00_05_0.text: I'm going to use that attack to my advantage!

V0614_34_00_07_0.text: The effect damage is going to be negated twice!

V0614_34_00_07_1.text:

Think of it as only twice.

V0614_34_00_08_0.text: If you want to capture me, defeat us in a Duel.

V0614_34_00_09_0.text: I can't tell you what to do. You must decide on your own.

V0614_34_00_10_0.text: I know when you're telling the truth and when you're lying.

V0614_34_00_11_0.text: This Duelist isn't trying to trick us.

V0614_34_00_12_0.text: I looked into your soul, so I know you're lying.

V0614_34_00_13_0.text: ...I can't tell if they're being honest or deceitful.

V0614_34_00_14_0.text: This Duelist is the type who loves to crush their opponent.

V0614_34_00_15_0.text: No one wants that to happen.

V0614_34_00_16_0.text: Do you not care about anything!?

Together, there's nothing we can't do, Blue Maiden!
